text: I'm sorry to hear that your clay bowl didn't turn out as expected. It can be frustrating when our creations don't meet our vision. You might consider setting the bowl aside for now and coming back to it when you're feeling more positive about it. For your next attempt, you might want to focus on one specific aspect, such as keeping the rim even, rather than trying to tackle everything at once. Remember, the outcome of one attempt doesn't define the next, and it's okay to take things one step at a time.
